Package edu.ntnu.stud.idatg2003.frontend.controllers

Class ChaosGameController

java.lang.Object
edu.ntnu.stud.idatg2003.frontend.controllers.ChaosGameController
public class ChaosGameController extends Object
The ChaosGameController class manages the Chaos Game simulation. It initializes the game, updates its state, and handles observers that monitor changes.
Since:
0.0.3 (The version of Chaos-Game application when introduced)

      public int calculateFractalPoint(String fractalType, double zx, double zy, int order, double cRe, double cIm, int maxIterations)
